message.content: Based on the information provided, there isn't explicit mention of Li Hua inviting Yuriko to play music together prior to Wolfgang proposing to pause playing musical instruments. The conversation shows that Wolfgang first introduced Yuriko to Li Hua, suggesting her for participation in a jam session. After Wolfgang brought up the idea of pausing his own instrument playing, Li Hua responded positively and asked Wolfgang to reach out to Yuriko to see if she was interested in joining their jam session. Thus, Wolfgang's suggestion regarding pausing musical instrument playing seems to precede Li Hua's invitation to Yuriko.
